concepts.gloss_en: The serpent (the primordial snake as a mystical archetype/בחינה of evil, servitude/Canaan)

members.note: representative; used as בחינת נחש / הנחש for the singular serpent-archetype
definite article on the same singular mythic serpent; the bare form itself appears as הַנָּחָשׁ in its own proofs, so no archetype split — 'the serpent' is one referent throughout

notes: The serpent is a single mythic entity, so the definite article does not distinguish an archetype from a generic member (unlike צדיק/הצדיק). Both forms are used identically as בחינת (ה)נחש representing evil/servitude. Kept as one concept but tiered 'likely' rather than 'obvious' since the article is a real morphological difference.
